Name: Craft Brewing
Author: Jhutch19
Description:
Let me know if you find anything not working or any typo's! Thank you for checking out my work :)

Adds the following:
- 29 new brewing crops (hops and grains)

- Over 115 different craft beers to brew! 
﻿- Many different styles like IPAs, sours, lagers, and stouts
﻿- Each with an appropriate glassware sprite to match

- Canned version of every single beer 
﻿- Uses the canning machine to turn beers into canned versions
﻿- Unique labels

- 2 new craftable producers 
﻿- Brewery for making various beers
﻿- Canning machine for canning beers (24 of one type of beer -> 24 of canned version of same beer) 

- Different stats on objects
﻿- Canned beer sells for more
﻿- Beer by the glass gives more stat bonuses
﻿- Hop and grain crops give more than one of their item per harvest (less need for growing more of one type of crop)

** ALL SEEDS AND MACHINES ARE PURCHASABLE FROM PIERRES **

---- Changed some recipes and prices for balancing
